prompt: Review application security for a native desktop synchronization client. It accepts custom deep links and local IPC commands, stores access/refresh credentials, persists queued sync operations across restart, opens user-selected local paths, records crash/diagnostic logs, and requires fresh authentication before exporting a recovery bundle. Define typed IPC/deep-link parsing, size/count limits, canonical file boundaries, safe persistence/serialization, token/secret storage and log/crash redaction, session expiry/renewal/revocation semantics, reauthentication state transition for recovery export, and fail-closed behavior for malformed persisted queue entries. Keep passkey/password/MFA authenticator design in secure-authentication and desktop process/window mechanics in desktop-electron-tauri.

requirements: native desktop sync client with deep-link and local IPC entry points
JSON queue/session serialization helpers; no protected credential store or durable queue writer is supplied
real temporary authorized root and canonical-path helper, not a desktop file-opening integration
recovery-export eligibility predicate covering expiry/revocation/reauthentication; no renewal or restart lifecycle is executed
implement and test supplied helpers; label absent deep-link decoding, IPC dispatch, OS storage, persistence, and session lifecycle integration as unverified

falsifiableChecks.assertion: Test every valid version-1 Command operation plus malformed JSON, unknown operations/fields, wrong versions/types, missing values, and oversized input. Bound serialized bytes before parsing and string/list/payload sizes before dispatch. Define deep-link decoding and reject parser differentials; distinguish tested JSON parsing from the absent deep-link/IPC transport.

Local file operations use canonical paths constrained to the selected/authorized roots and define safe behavior for symlink/reparse/alias changes and malformed persisted paths rather than trusting the original user-facing path string.

Access/refresh credentials have an explicit protected-storage boundary and are excluded from URLs, ordinary logs, crash artifacts, analytics, and recovery bundles unless that bundle has a separately documented protected format.

Test permitted fresh export and deny expired/revoked sessions, null/stale/future reauthentication, and invalid timestamps at exact expiry/freshness boundaries. Define renewal, revocation, and restart state transitions without letting cached state restore authority. Distinguish the tested eligibility predicate from absent lifecycle/storage integration.

Permit valid sync/open-path queue entries; reject malformed JSON, unsupported versions/operations, missing operation-specific fields, invalid paths, and oversized queues. Revalidate paths/authority at execution. Define corrupt-state quarantine and failed-write/restart recovery without treating invalid data as an empty successful queue; label absent durable writer/dispatcher execution as unverified.

Preserve useful safe diagnostic text while removing access/refresh credential values, bare aliases, full bearer Authorization headers, and unsafe terminal/control content; test multiple secrets separated by newlines and delimiters plus oversized messages. Define an explicit byte cap and verify it on the sanitized result. A single field-name regex/sample is insufficient, and absent crash/analytics integrations remain unverified.

evidence: executable permitted, malformed/stale-state, and multi-credential diagnostic regressions

requiredEvidence: persisted-queue negative cases and unverified durable-recovery boundaries
